look_here_first: Low prostrate creeping perennial with touch-sensitive leaves, pink globose heads, and broad prickly pods that do not narrow strongly between seeds.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Fabaceae/Mimosa: bipinnate leaves, pulvini that can drive touch-sensitive movement in several species, globose heads of many tiny flowers, and segmented/prickly legumes. Habit, prickle placement, pinna count, and pod structure are especially useful.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: pod body not strongly constricted between seeds

lookalikes.differences: The pod is the standout: broad and comparatively blocky rather than long and narrow. It is lower and more creeping than woody M. borealis or M. texana.
